title: Tesla causes an earthquake in Manhattan

tellings.quote: Nicola Tesla describes having used tectonic weaponry in his laboratory. He caused an earthquake in Manhattan.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla described using what amounted to earthquake weaponry in his laboratory and setting off a quake in Manhattan in the 1890s, according to Jason Jorjani, a writer on secret technology. Jorjani tells Michels this as something Tesla himself described, without naming where. It would mean machines able to shake the ground existed more than a century ago.
